lines.trans: Vitya, do not worry, everything will be fine.
I know all your cooks very well!
Someone will always mix everything up or forget.
They recently fired a worker like that here.
Viktoriya Sergeyevna, excuse me, we have an emergency.
The sanitary service is closing our restaurant today.
What do you mean closing, why did this suddenly happen?
During the inspection in the storeroom they found rodents.

lines.trans: I am forced to suspend the operation of your restaurant.
The restaurant is closed until the elimination of all violations.
But where did rats come from in our place?
It is a pity they did not catch the main rat!

meanings.note: Declinable feminine noun meaning 'elimination', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Ресторан закрыт до устранения всех нарушений.

examples.trans: Vitya, do not worry, everything will be fine.

meanings.note: Verbal action or result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание', meaning 'violation' in conversational and formal Russian.

examples.text: Ресторан закрыт до устранения всех нарушений.
examples.trans: The restaurant is closed until the elimination of all violations.

examples.text: Нарушений я не нашёл.
examples.trans: I found no violations.

examples.trans: That is a violation of the law.

meanings.note: Coordinating or subordinating Russian conjunction meaning 'but', linking clauses in spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Но этот букет я не возьму.
examples.trans: But I will not take this bouquet.

examples.text: Ого, но она же родная дочь шефа!
examples.trans: Whoa, but she is the chef's own daughter!

examples.text: Но откуда у нас взялись крысы?
examples.trans: But where did rats come from in our place?

meanings.note: Invariable Russian adverb used to modify verbs or whole clauses with the sense 'where from'.

examples.text: Но откуда у нас взялись крысы?

examples.text: Откуда ты?
examples.trans: Where are you from?

examples.trans: Where does that word come from?

meanings.note: Prefix 'вз-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (root 'яться'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to appear', forming an aspectual pair with 'браться'.

examples.text: Но откуда у нас взялись крысы?
examples.trans: But where did rats come from in our place?

examples.trans: Where did the goose come from?

examples.text: Откуда здесь взялся этот гусь?
examples.trans: Where did this goose come from?

жаль.gloss: it is a pity, too bad

meanings.en: it is a pity, too bad
meanings.note: Invariable Russian adverb used to modify verbs or whole clauses with the sense 'it is a pity'.

examples.text: Жаль, что главную крысу не поймали!
examples.trans: It is a pity that they did not catch the main rat!

examples.text: Жаль только, что горячее не успели поесть!
examples.trans: It is just a pity we did not get to eat the main course!

examples.text: Жаль, что нельзя запустить проект.
examples.trans: It is a pity that the project cannot be launched.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronoun ('what') that declines for case depending on its grammatical function in the sentence.

examples.text: Подождите, а это ещё что такое?
examples.trans: Wait, and what on earth is this?

examples.text: Выходит, что леопарды тоже нас спасают.
examples.trans: It turns out that the leopards save us too.

examples.text: Так что приготовьте обед очень быстро.
examples.trans: So prepare lunch very quickly.

meanings.note: Descriptive Russian adjective meaning 'main', agreeing in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Жаль, что главную крысу не поймали!
examples.trans: It is a pity that they did not catch the main rat!

examples.text: И главное, вы очень благородный гость.
examples.trans: And most importantly, you are a very noble guest.

examples.text: Главное — не волнуйся.
examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (root 'ймать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to catch', forming an aspectual pair with 'ловить'.

examples.text: Жаль, что главную крысу не поймали!
examples.trans: It is a pity that they did not catch the main rat!

examples.text: Ты вчера бандитов поймал!

examples.text: Ты бандитов поймал! Которые банкомат на Гарибальди ограбили.
